subject: Important Update on Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about a recent security update that has been implemented on our online platform. In order to enhance the security of your account, we have added a two-step verification process. Please log in to your account and follow the instructions to set up this additional security measure. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
